name: Hot Termite 89
author: guilhermeyohan
description: Gradient rounded gray text input that glows and scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, border becomes solid 1.9px #000002, transform becomes scale(1.03), box-shadow becomes 1px 1px 5px #858585. On focus, the outline is removed, box-shadow becomes 1px 2px 5px #858585, transform becomes translateY(-95%) scale(0.9).
